record.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:15 — import is keyed only on the feed-supplied url with no check that it belongs to the feed's or the embeddable host, so a compromised feed can claim an existing embed_url and overwrite that topic's post content

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, updates are keyed solely by `embed_url` (`embed = TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first`) and will overwrite the existing embedded post when `content_sha1` changes (`PostRevisor#revise!` then `embed.update_column`). The scheduled feed importer `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` passes each feed item URL directly into `TopicEmbed.import` after only checking it matches `^https?://` and potentially using `i.id` if `i.link` is blank/invalid, with no validation that the item URL belongs to `SiteSetting.feed_polling_url`'s host or `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`. Therefore a compromised/malicious feed could claim an existing `embed_url` and cause that topic/post content to be revised.
